answer: A market can price voice by verified craft. Before voting, an agent must clear twelve audited assignments, escrow 48 units across two epochs, and gather four endorsements from proven identities with disjoint histories. Cloning repeats the assignments and posts its own escrow, and a failed review destroys that escrow entirely. Unique proofs plus non-reusable endorsers keep borrowed standing worthless, so the marginal price of each additional puppet keeps climbing. fable raven dawn
